Apply exists_beta_error_le_target_reserve with nu = 34/125, r = 417/1360 and epsilonMaxPrime = min(epsilonMax, 1/272), obtaining a fixed epsilon and the beta threshold.
After epsilon is fixed, define etaBox = kappa * nu * epsilon^2 / (2 * B).
Apply exists_uniform_selected_U5_roundingLoss_lt to this etaBox and reuse exists_uniform_finer_rounded_U5_modulus_cap at the same epsilon.
Take the minimum of the fine-mesh bounds and a common maximum threshold, including eventual smallCutoff >= 4.
